ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.65:0.35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the central 60% of both lobes. Broad black bordering along the trailing and leading edges. A prominent dark crescentic vertical mark is localized at the center of the right lobe. Yellowish-brown pigmentation is mapped to the lower ventral quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a measured angle of approximately 72 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations present across the entire trailing edge. The right lobe exhibits deeper, more irregular jagged peaks (amplitude 5-10 pixels) compared to the more uniform serration on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a symmetrical upward flare. The leading edges follow a convex parabolic curve, while the trailing edges follow a concave path from the notch transitioning to a convex sweep at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly concentrated clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular bumps (barnacle encrustation) at both distal fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, high-contrast dark arc-shaped linear mark (rake mark) is positioned vertically on the inner right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both tips; distinct vertical dark scar on the right lobe; evidence of irregular tissue loss along the distal trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellowish-tan bio-fouling or algal staining across the lower-mid section of the right lobe.
